title: Figure 14: functional designation of physical cockpit panels layout
description: Grey-scale block layout of a cockpit panel arrangement with labelled regions: Navigation Display, Vector Motion Display, Flight Assist Interactive Display, Flight Mode, Vehicle Status, Cabin Control, Comm. Control, Key Pad, External Sensing, Internal Conditions, Pullout Keyboard and Periphery Motion Displays, plus "Dual Six-Degree Joysticks," survival enunciator and emergency response. Captioned "Figure 14. Functional Designation of Physical Cockpit Panels. Basic layout of the physical displays and controls. [Credit: M. Millis]."
